notes.title: New: Clear mention of the "good ending" lock
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, and Merry Christmas!

As a small extra gift under the Christmas tree, we published an update for Necro Story today!
We fixed a few small bugs and we added a feature that some of you might consider important.

If you played the game already, you noticed that something weird happens the first time you die. We initially wanted to keep the surprise about this, but it seems that many players are upset to discover that it could lock some parts of the story. We understand their reaction and wanted to do something about it. So this update's most important point is to warn the player about the consequence of picking one of the options when dying for the first time.
We won't tell you more in order to not spoil it too much, but we believed that with the current version, player who wants to reach 100% completion from their very first game won't get upset anymore.

By the way, did you know that Necro Story features 5 different endings?

We at Rablo Games wish you a very happy holiday season!

Take care,

-
Pablo and the Rablo Games team

notes.title: Necro story is now available
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're a little late with the news, but as you may have noticed, Necro Story is [b]now available[/b]!
This is a huge deal for us, and we are really happy to let you finally play the whole game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35959816/07cd8505a3759f0e78a2303b6d95a040eb37b640.png[/img]

We're also pretty excited with the reception of the game so far. We prepared an accolade trailer with some of the nice comments and quotes from the press.

[previewyoutube=c2vvSd2xMrY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











So far, player reviews aligns with the press, as we have a 94% positive review score on Steam! This is huge and we would like to thank all the players who took the time to review the game. <3

However, we currently have only 38 reviews, so we're still missing 12 of them to reach the very important 50 reviews milestone. It would potentially give a a very positive rating on Steam along with extra visibility. So feel free to leave a review with your opinion on the game if you have the time. This would help us a lot!

And don't hesitate to leave us a message on the Steam forums if you have any question for us. We will do our best to reply everyone!

Thank you for reading us! We really hope you'll have a great time playing the game!

-
Pablo and the Rablo Games team

notes.title: Necro Story demo has been updated!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The release of Necro Story is fast approaching! Only 9 days to go until the final game launch!

In case you want to (re)play Necro Story before the game releases on October 7th, please note we updated the demo. Here is a non-exhaustive list of the main changes:

- It is not necessary to drag and drop the souls and mana fragments on the necromancer anymore. Just right clicking them will absorb them automatically. This is a common request we received after publishing the demo back in May, and we think the game is much better like this. Thank you for pointing this out!

- We made it easier to catch the souls with the mouse. The zone around the soul that can trigger the mouse pointer catching it is now bigger.

- Controller support is more polished overall. Also the problems of detection between controller and mouse should be fixed. Please let us know if you still have those problems.

- We added support for a ton of new languages. 8 new languages actually, so the current supported language list is the following: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. If you find any mistake in any of these languages, please let us know and we'll update the game.


There are lots of other changes, like friendly rats popping up during combats in the castle and bug fixes, but the list would be too long.

Also note that as with the previous version, you can play the demo, then continue your game in the full game without restarting everything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35959816/07cd8505a3759f0e78a2303b6d95a040eb37b640.png[/img]

We hope you'll have a great time with the new demo, and are looking forward to your feedback!

-
Pablo and the Rablo Games team

notes.title: Necro Story will release on October 7th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After more than 6 years of development, we're thrilled to announce that Necro Story now has a release date! You will be able to enjoy Necro Story on Steam from the 7th of October. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35959816/fca645025810fbb4bee755cb1f53f27e713693e8.jpg[/img]

In case you've just seen the light and decided to open this post without knowing what Necro Story is about, it's a Creature-Collection RPG in which you play as a (kind of) evil necromancer more into undead shenanigans than saving the world. Summon minions, outsmart foes, and snag their souls to power up your team. With witty banter from ghostly sidekick Vivi, expect strategic combat, laughs, and plenty of mischief.

To celebrate the release date announcement, we published a new trailer! 

[previewyoutube=mfZaRYi_Mfw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











We'd like to thank you all for your patience during the long years it took to make this game. We hope you'll like the result of our work!


Don't hesitate to add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/968800?utm_source=steamnews]wishlist[/url] and follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Rablo_Games]Rablo Games[/url] on Steam if you feel like it. It's always a great help! <3


Cheers,

-
Pablo and the Rablo Games team

notes.title: Necro Story - Development update June 23rd 2024
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Steam Next Fest is now behind us, and I hope you had the chance to try some cool game demos!
Necro Story demo will be available on the Steam page until the release, so feel free to play it anytime you like if you didn’t have time to test it yet (or want to play it again ^^').

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35959816/e13197fe02020b93ae189e2902487400b6a8f7cd.png[/img]

We’d like to say a big thanks to all players who took the time to share their feedback with us, or to cheer us on in the forums. A comment that seems to be shared by many players is that the drag and dropping of souls and mana fragments could become tedious after a while, and we decided to tweak this for the final version. Here is a list of things we are currently working on:

Mana fragments: 
There is no need to drag & drop the mana fragments on the necromancer to absorb them anymore. Just right click on the mana fragment and release the button, it will automatically be absorbed. This makes absorption of Mana Fragment MUCH easier and quicker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35959816/06336817654e0bb0f41153332add8f1b17f40d69.gif[/img]

Souls:
As for mana fragments, you can now just click them and release the right mouse button to absorb souls automatically. If you want to CAPTURE the enemy, just hold the right button and drag the soul on the soul vessel, like in the demo. We’re still evaluating if this should be the default option or a custom rule, but the option will be in the game.

We also received feedback from players who found it frustrating that the difficulty of catching souls was quite high after a while, so we’re adding custom rules allowing you to reduce the speed of souls if you so wish. Actually we’re adding a fair amount of other custom rules allowing you to modify the game in the way you want it to be played.

We’re also adding new global mechanics in order to increase the player choices and possibilities during battle. One of them allows you to drag a mana fragment on the filled Soul Vessel, consuming part of the Vessel in exchange for a big mana bonus. 
Another thing we’re exploring is to add a Magic Boost gauge, giving the necromancer a time-limited boost of Magic after dealing a set amount of damage in a given battle.

Feel free to further share your feedback in the forums, we will read everything and continue improving the game until the release.

Cheers,

-
Pablo and the Rablo Games team

notes.title: Diablo meets Pokemon in undead Steam RPG, with demo out now
notes.notes:
I love slaying demons in the murky depths of Diablo's Sanctuary as much as the next Necromancer, but every now and then, it's nice to dive into something a little more light-hearted. The new indie game Necro Story from Belgian developer Rablo Games could be just the trick, promising a "whimsical" adventure through the Underworld with plenty of magic, humor, and hidden secrets. Oh, and you can capture the souls of your enemies for your undead army, a bit like Pokemon - just not quite as cuddly.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Necro Story demo is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have some great news to share with you today!

After more than 6 years of development, [b]it’s finally time to let you try the Necro Story demo![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35959816/c97aae67546d29705f721d2dd2b40eb6ec8867b5.jpg[/img]

Just click the "Download Demo" link on Necro Story's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/968800/Necro_Story/]Steam page[/url] and you're ready to go!  We’re super excited that this moment has finally arrived, and we’re looking forward to reading all your feedback! Feel free to let us know what you think of the game in the Steam forums or on our [url=https://discord.gg/xTPJSMdh8e]Discord server[/url]. It will help us make the game better! 
I’m sure you’re also wondering when the final game will be released. We still have some polishing to do and are planning to release in September 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35959816/bc11e9d0b62cdafea6bb07ea93e041519f2ecbd4.png[/img]

It’s been a long road to get to this point and we really hope you’ll have a great time playing the demo of Necro Story! 

Thank you for your patience and support!

-
Pablo and the Rablo Games team
